proves.claim: A claim through the production command appends exactly one seat-ready mark after its claim event, and a mark write forced to fail leaves the claim standing with the mark in the spool.

cli.claim.seat-ready-mark.why: Without it, the timeline cannot tell a seat still setting up its folder from one that is building, and a busy board could fail a claim over a mark.

proves.claim: One seat-ready mark is one append: 50 marks on a fixture board write 50 events and nothing spools, with the p95 of the append stated.

cli.claim.seat-ready-latency.why: Without it, the cost the mark adds to a claim is a guess.

proves.claim: pullboard test by the seat holding the claim appends finish start and finish end with the exit code, a seat without the claim appends none, and the timeline shows the stages in order with the finish span as testing.

cli.test.finish-marks.why: Without it, a builder's test run is invisible inside one building stretch.
